source_text: Spera in Domino et fac bonitatem; inhabita terram et pasceris in divitiis eius. Terra haec — cor auditoris, agri animae. Delectare in Domino, et dabit tibi petitiones cordis tui. Revela Domino viam tuam et spera in eum. Educet sicut lumen iustitiam tuam. Gloria Christo. Amen.
thought_title: Hope in the Lord and the land as the heart
orientation: Origen is expounding Psalm 36 (LXX), applying its commands to the hearer's soul.
pass_a_gloss: Hope [you singular] in [the] Lord and do goodness; inhabit [the] land and you will be fed in [the] riches of it. [The] land this — [the] heart of [the] hearer, [the] fields of [the] soul. Delight [you singular] in [the] Lord, and he will give to you [the] petitions of [the] heart of you. Reveal [you singular] to [the] Lord [the] way of you and hope [you singular] in him. May he lead forth as light [the] justice of you. Glory to Christ. Amen.

choices.why: The glossary and brief use 'hope in the Lord' for this psalm command; 'spera' is imperative.
rejected: Put your hope in the Lord

choices.why: Keeps the literal noun 'goodness' rather than turning it into an adjective or adverb, matching the source's abstract noun.
The glossary fixes 'terra' as 'land'; 'inhabita' is the literal imperative.

choices.english: you will be fed in his riches
choices.why: Passive of 'pascor' means 'be fed'; 'in divitiis' is kept literal as 'in his riches'.
rejected: you will feed on his riches
you will be nourished by his riches

choices.term: Terra haec — cor auditoris, agri animae
choices.english: This land — the heart of the hearer, the fields of the soul
choices.why: Preserves the appositional gloss and the plural 'agri' as 'fields', matching the brief's spiritual reading of the land as the heart.
rejected: This land is the heart of the hearer, the field of the soul

choices.english: He will bring out your righteousness like light
choices.why: 'Educet' is future indicative; 'iustitia' is fixed as 'righteousness' by the glossary; 'sicut lumen' is literal.
rejected: He will bring forth your righteousness as light
He will lead out your justice like light

bible_refs.note: Spera in Domino et fac bonitatem; inhabita terram et pasceris in divitiis eius. Delectare in Domino, et dabit tibi petitiones cordis tui. Revela Domino viam tuam et spera in eum. Educet sicut lumen iustitiam tuam.

pass_b_english: Hope in the Lord and do goodness; inhabit the land and you will be fed in his riches (Psalm 37:3). This land is the heart of the hearer, the fields of the soul. Delight in the Lord, and he will give you the requests of your heart (Psalm 37:4). Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in him. He will bring out your righteousness like light (Psalm 37:5-6). Glory to Christ. Amen.
